title: LifeLimitz
description: A hardcore life management plugin featuring custom resurrection rituals. Limit lifes!
body:
LifeLimitz is not merely a life limit. It's an entire life, death and team interaction ecosystem!

Features:
-  Global Game Modes:
 - ban: The oldschool temp ban when running out of life.
 - spec: Players will be spectating permanently.
 - specrevive: Innovative teamwork-based mode with graves and revivals.
-  Grave System (specrevive):
 - A customizable grave will spawn on the exact player death location.
 - Friends are granted 7 days to bring them back from the dead.
 - Optimized: graves will be invisible if no player is near.
-  Resurrection Totem:
 - A legendary item for bringing back the fallen.
 - Cinematic Revival: Player is gracefully dropped from the sky with beautiful fireworks.
-  Anti-Relog (PvP Combat):
 - During battle, the BossBar will change into a Combat HUD with a timer and the opponent's name.
 - When the player attempts to relog during a combat, he will be rewarded with an item drop (explosion!) and life loss penalty.
-  Dynamic BossBar HUD:
 - A smart HUD changing from life display to PvP combat mode and back.

Commands & Permissions
- /lifez mode <ban|spec|specrevive> - Change global mode of plugin (Perm: lifelimitz.mode)
- /lifez give <player> <1|3|revive> - Grant player some of totems (Perm: lifelimitz.give)
- /lifez antirelog <on|off> - Enable/disable anti-relog system (Perm: lifelimitz.antirelog)
- /lifez set/add <player> <amount> - set/add lives to player (Perm: lifelimitz.set/add)
- /lifez lang <en|ru> - Change current language for you (Perm: all players).
